class Probe:
    comparisons = 0

    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value

    def __eq__(self, other):
        Probe.comparisons += 1
        return self.value == other.value

    def __hash__(self):
        return hash(self.value)


items = [Probe(i) for i in range(100)]
lookup = set(items)
target = Probe(99)
Probe.comparisons = 0
target in items
print(Probe.comparisons)
Probe.comparisons = 0
target in lookup
print(Probe.comparisons)
